body:
STORY-1689 is ready as two stacked PRs on #2846 (TASK-1945 S3a, the shared commit-CI reader, which the operator ships first).
- PR-2849 (Refs STORY-1689), head 1a48118949. PR1/C3: Forge::commit_checks(sha) through the shared reader on GitHub and GitLab. ci_status(Commit) is now SHA-keyed, and an error or no checks is CiState::None. 7 tests.
- PR-2850 (STORY-1689, the completing PR), head 2455fb40d9. 'aida dev build --if-main-green' plus the hidden child, the dev-autopromote job (15m) and its advisor route, and docs. Q1: the build is detached (its own systemd-run unit under the systemd driver, else setsid). Q2: not-live-source is checked before any fetch; .promoted now records its repo. Q3: every check is green and the 'Build (ubuntu-latest)' aggregator is required on GitHub. C1: an untracked file counts as dirty, and there is a re-probe under the same lock before the ff-only. C2: a failure is reported once, with the log tail on the routed line. C4: the docs say the operator deletes ~/bin/aida-autobuild.sh. 24 tests.
- Note: a legacy .promoted record has no repo, so the job skips not-live-source until one manual 'aida dev build' records it.
Gates (LIGHT): the targeted cargo tests and make check-ci-fast are green. #2846 moved to 239478f5ad after I branched; the stack merges cleanly by merge base, and I will update the branches if CI asks.
subject: READY: PR-2850 (STORY-1689)
